lines.text: The afflicted man asks the LORD to hear his prayer and not hide His face in his day of distress.
His days vanish like smoke, and he is like a desert owl and a lone bird on a housetop.
His enemies taunt him all day, and he has eaten ashes like bread because of God's indignation and wrath.
The LORD sits enthroned forever, and He will have compassion on Sinai and rebuild it.
The LORD looked down from heaven to hear a prisoner's groaning, so that people may praise Him in Bethel.
